attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: শুক্রবার রাত থেকে রবিবার পর্যন্ত ছুটির সময়।

definition.oewn_definition: a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
definition.text: a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday

examples.bn: এই সপ্তাহান্তে আমরা দাদু-দিদার বাড়িতে যাব।
examples.en: We are visiting our grandparents this weekend.
